items.title: Como score nine to make Champions League history
items.summary: Anastasios Douvikas scores a hat-trick as Como produce a stunning 9-1 away win over Lens on match day four, recording the biggest away win in Champions League history.

items.title: Haaland scores winner as Man City beat Leipzig
items.summary: Erling Haaland scores the winning goal as Manchester City overcome being pegged back twice to beat RB Leipzig 3-2 on match day four of the UEFA Champions League group phase.

items.title: Arsenal survive late Slavia scare for hard-fought win
items.summary: Arsenal earn their third win from four in the Champions League as goals from Noni Madueke and Victor Gyokeres are too much for Slavia Prague, despite a valiant late fight from the hosts to get back into the game.

items.title: Liverpool crumble at Kuyt's Fenerbahce
items.summary: Liverpool are defeated by Turkish side Fenerbahce, who twice fought back from behind to seal a famous victory, ending the Reds' perfect start to this year's Champions League after four games.

items.title: Bellingham backheel and Valverde rocket earn Real late win at AEK
items.summary: Real Madrid continue their 100% start to their Champions League campaign with another late win, this time through captain Federico Valverde to inflict Athens' third loss in a row.

items.title: Manchester United beat Roma in epic second-half comeback
items.summary: Manchester United drag themselves up off the canvas to come from two goals down to record a sensational Champions League victory against Roma at Old Trafford.
